script: On a dark night, you can see light that is about two and a half million years old. It comes from the Andromeda Galaxy, the most distant thing most people can see with their bare eyes. That light left Andromeda before modern humans even existed. Andromeda is moving toward us at about 110 kilometers per second. Billions of years from now, it may collide and merge with our own Milky Way. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
